mapper.select: SELECT #{baseDate} AS base_date, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(amount) FROM ledger WHERE posting_date = #{baseDate} AND journal_type = 'LOAN_RECEIVABLE' ), 0) AS disbursed_amount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ledger WHERE posting_date = #{baseDate} AND journal_type = 'LOAN_RECEIVABLE' ), 0) AS disbursed_count, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(l.amount) FROM ledger l JOIN payment_instruction p ON p.payment_instruction_id = l.payment_instruction_id WHERE l.posting_date = #{baseDate} AND l.journal_type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' AND p.sender_user_id = 'LOAN_SERVICE' ), 0) AS repaid_amount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ledger l JOIN payment_instruction p ON p.payment_instruction_id = l.payment_instruction_id WHERE l.posting_date = #{baseDate} AND l.journal_type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' AND p.sender_user_id = 'LOAN_SERVICE' ), 0) AS repaid_count
